title: Three Elders of Mulan
summary: After a year of seclusion, Xiao Yan learns that the Chu Yun, Luo Yan and Mulan Empires have attacked the Jia Ma Empire, held back only by Medusa and the Snakemen Clan. At the Black Mountain Fortress, the Gold Geese Sect leader Yan Luo Tian and the Three Elders of Mulan gang up on the wounded Medusa. Xiao Yan arrives as a Dou Huang, gives Medusa a pill and takes on the three elders himself. They attack with the Three Beast Savage Skill, which lets one elder at a time wield a Dou Zong's power. Xiao Yan boosts himself with the Luminous Jadeite Change and his Heavenly Flame. He sees the skill's weak point and decoys it with clones from the Three Thousand Lightning Movement. He then takes Elder Hutou out with an Octane Blast and faces the last two elders.
